description: Resolve a country name (or an existing ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code) to its uppercase ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code — e.g. "Kenya" → "KE". Useful before calling check_visa. Returns an error if the name can't be resolved.

name.description: A country name or ISO-2 code, e.g. "Kenya" or "KE".

name: country_code
title: Resolve a country name to its ISO-2 code
